subject: SIG questionnaire: schema rework, evidence gap list and delivery plan
messages:
From: Alice Kim <alice@cloudridge.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@cloudridge.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: SIG request and version questions for procurement

Hi Karthik,

Following up from procurement — CloudRidge needs a completed SIG that maps our baseline controls to your latest answers. We were provided SIG v2 last quarter, but legal is now asking for the updated schema and any re-answers or deltas between versions (they referenced a new SIG schema that was circulated internally).

Could you confirm:
- Which SIG version Redwood will submit (v2, v2.1, v3)?
- A short diff (controls changed / answers changed) and clarifying notes for any items that moved from "Yes" to "Partial" or vice versa.
- Evidence for any control where the answer changed or is marked as "partial" (logs, configuration screenshots, control owner confirmation).

Our target for review is EOD next Tuesday (2027-02-23). If you can share an initial package or a drive link with the files and a short gap list, that would speed legal sign-off.

Thanks — appreciate a quick ack.

Alice Kim
Security Lead, CloudRidge
alice@cloudridge.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kim <alice@cloudridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG request and version questions for procurement

Hi Alice — thanks for the note and the deadline. Short answer: we plan to submit a consolidated SIG package aligned to the new schema (we're calling it SIG v3 internally) and include a diff + re-answer matrix that highlights changes from the v2 baseline.

What we'll deliver by EOD Monday (US time):
- Complete SIG file in the new schema (SIG_reanswers_draft.xlsx)
- A compact diff summary (reanswer-diff.txt) describing each changed control and reason
- Evidence index and a Drive folder with artifacts (logs sample, config screenshots)

Open items for your guidance:
- Are interim evidence artifacts acceptable for controls where full attestation requires engineering time (we can provide logs and screenshots now, full audit exports next week)?
- Any specific controls you want prioritized for the legal review?

Attaching the request form we received (SIG_v3_request_form.pdf) and our internal plan (reanswer-plan.md). Marissa will lead the re-answers; Neha will collect evidence. Jon is on copy for escalation if we need exceptions.

Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: SIG v3 re-answer / evidence tasking (CloudRidge)

Team — forwarding CloudRidge ask. Fast turnaround; target is EOD Mon (internal) so we can ship to them Mon evening and let their legal have Tue to review.

Action items:
- Marissa: lead the re-answers and produce the diff summary. Please use the SIG template and mark answers with change reasons.
- Neha: assemble evidence pack and an evidence-index.xlsx that maps each attestation to artifacts (logs, screenshots, owner contact). If any artifacts are missing, call it out in the gaplist.
- Jonas: review any items we flag as exceptions/partial and confirm with security whether we should propose compensating controls.

I will draft the cover email to CloudRidge once we have the package. Keep replies short — I will consolidate.

Karthik

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 11:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG v3 re-answer / evidence tasking (CloudRidge)

Quick update — putting artifacts into the shared folder now. Evidence index attached. High-level gaps:

- Control SIG-3.4 (retention exports): need one additional archive export (engineering scheduled Wed 02/24) — currently providing logs-sample.pdf and a timestamped S3 listing.
- Control SIG-7.1 (privileged access reviews): only partial — we have last quarter's report but no auditor-signed attestation yet. Proposed interim artifact: access-review-screenshots.png and owner confirmation email.
- Control SIG-12.2 (incident triage): full playbook attached, but running incident timelines need anonymized mail threads we will sanitize.

Attachments: evidence-index.xlsx, logs-sample.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b-CloudRidge-SIG-pack (w/ structured path: /evidence, /reanswers, /diffs)

Neha
Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 15:27:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG v3 re-answer / evidence tasking (CloudRidge)

Attached is the first draft of re-answers (SIG_reanswers_draft.xlsx) and a short diff text file (reanswer-diff.txt). Notes:

- Most answers carried forward; ~18 items updated from Yes -> Partial or Partial -> Yes based on new schema granularity. Each changed item includes a brief rationale and responsible owner.
- For items we flagged as "partial", I've proposed compensating measures (see column "CompensatingControl"). Some items will need security/legal sign-off before we present to CloudRidge.
- Please pay attention to SIG-7.1 and SIG-3.4 (Neha note above).

Next steps: Jon, can you review the proposed compensating controls? Karthik, if you're happy I'll package everything and send to Alice with the Drive link.

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Kim <alice@cloudridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: SIG v3 package and gap list for CloudRidge — delivery

Hi Alice — attaching our consolidated SIG package and evidence folder for your legal review. Summary of what's included:

- SIG_reanswers_draft.xlsx (complete answers in the v3 schema)
- reanswer-diff.txt (control-level deltas + short rationale)
- evidence-index.xlsx (map of controls -> artifacts)
- logs-sample.pdf (sanitized log excerpts for retention control)
- Additional artifacts available in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b-CloudRidge-SIG-pack

Open items and proposed interim approach:
- SIG-3.4 (retention exports): we can provide interim logs and an S3 listing now; the full archive export is scheduled for Wed 2027-02-24.
- SIG-7.1 (privileged access reviews): interim evidence (screenshots + owner confirmation) provided; auditor-signed attestation expected by 2027-03-03.

If interim artifacts are acceptable for legal review, we'll consider the package complete for your first pass. Otherwise, tell us which controls must have final attestation before your team will proceed.

Please acknowledge receipt and let us know if you want a short walkthrough call (15 minutes) tomorrow.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SIG_reanswers_draft.xlsx (sheet: answers), reanswer-diff.txt, evidence-index.xlsx, logs-sample.pdf
